title: Apple (NASDAQ_AAPL) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q1 CY2026
content: iPhone and iPad maker Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 16.6% year on year to $111.2 billion. Its GAAP profit of $2.01 per share was 3.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

title: Apple Ends 'Net-Cash Neutral' Policy
content: Back in the 2010s, Apple had a problem: it had too much cash, and more kept coming in.  The company began paying dividends and buying back shares, managing a complex balance sheet that includes cash, investments, and debt.  It announced a plan to get to bring those in line, and get net cash close to zero through an aggressive return of cash through share buybacks and dividends.

title: Cook_ Memory Costs Will Be Increasing Impact On Our Business
content: Apple isn't totally immune to memory-cost headwinds. Apple CEO Tim Cook told shareholders on Thursday that while things are under control for now, memory-cost headwinds are expected to get worse in the months ahead.

title: Apple Stock Jumps on Revenue Outlook
content: Apple gave a better-than-expected sales forecast for its current quarter during the conference call Thursday, sending shares higher. Apple said it expects fiscal third-quarter revenue to grow between 14% to 17% from the prior year, which is better than analyst estimates for 9% growth.

title: The iPhone Halo Effect
content: Apple continues to bring iPhone users into the larger family of Apple products. On the company's earnings call Thursday, chief financial officer Kevan Parekh said that Apple set a March quarter record for customers new to the Mac, with over half of iPad and Watch sales to customers who were new to the product.
